coupons_value_matches_kind.name: coupons_value_matches_kind
coupons_value_matches_kind.value:
("coupons"."kind" = 'percent' and "coupons"."percent_off" between 1 and 100 and "coupons"."amount_off_kobo" is null)
        or ("coupons"."kind" = 'fixed' and "coupons"."amount_off_kobo" > 0 and "coupons"."percent_off" is null)
